scope: Phase 1 scoped research; not a systematic clinical review

sources.title: Choosing a safe and successful weight-loss program
sources.finding: A useful program combines appropriate eating, activity, ongoing support and realistic goals.
sources.limitation: General guidance, not an individualized assessment.
sources.refresh_trigger: Before implementation of dependent health content or store submission; sooner if source changes

sources.title: Body Weight Planner
sources.finding: Provides a research-based approach to estimating weight-related changes over time.
sources.limitation: Do not claim the app implements or validates this model until it does; eligibility and inputs need review.
sources.refresh_trigger: Before implementation of dependent health content or store submission; sooner if source changes

sources.title: Intermittent fasting and type 2 diabetes
sources.finding: Fasting needs population-specific consideration; studies often exclude eating-disorder history and evidence gaps remain.
sources.limitation: Expert discussion is not a universal OMAD safety assessment.
sources.refresh_trigger: Before implementation of dependent health content or store submission; sooner if source changes

sources.title: Calorie restriction with or without time-restricted eating
sources.publisher: Liu et al., NEJM via PubMed
sources.finding: In 139 adults with obesity, adding an eating window did not significantly improve 12-month weight outcomes over calorie restriction alone.
sources.limitation: One specific eating window and study population; not a direct OMAD trial.
sources.refresh_trigger: Before implementation of dependent health content or store submission; sooner if source changes

sources.title: Reduced meal frequency without caloric restriction
sources.publisher: Stote et al., AJCN via PubMed
sources.finding: Compared one versus three meals during two eight-week periods with weight-maintenance food intake.
sources.limitation: Small pilot and short periods cannot establish long-term suitability for this owner.
sources.refresh_trigger: Before implementation of dependent health content or store submission; sooner if source changes

sources.title: Reduced meal frequency and glucose regulation
sources.publisher: Carlson et al., Metabolism via PubMed
sources.finding: The one-meal condition produced less favorable morning glucose responses than three meals in the studied protocol.
sources.limitation: Protocol/population specific; do not extrapolate to every fasting pattern.
sources.refresh_trigger: Before implementation of dependent health content or store submission; sooner if source changes

sources.title: Carnivore diet survey of 2029 adults
sources.publisher: Lennerz et al., Current Developments in Nutrition via PubMed
sources.finding: Respondents reported satisfaction and perceived benefits; a lipid-reporting subset had elevated LDL.
sources.limitation: Self-selected, self-reported, uncontrolled evidence; cannot establish causation or long-term safety.
sources.refresh_trigger: Before implementation of dependent health content or store submission; sooner if source changes

sources.title: DIETFITS randomized clinical trial
sources.publisher: Gardner et al., JAMA via PubMed
sources.finding: Healthy low-fat and healthy low-carbohydrate groups did not differ significantly in 12-month weight change.
sources.limitation: Does not prove all dietary methods equivalent or validate strict keto for everyone.
sources.refresh_trigger: Before implementation of dependent health content or store submission; sooner if source changes

sources.title: Mediterranean diet primary cardiovascular prevention
sources.publisher: Estruch et al., NEJM via PubMed
sources.finding: Reanalysis supports cardiovascular prevention benefits in the older, high-risk PREDIMED population.
sources.limitation: Population and cardiovascular outcomes differ from a younger person's appearance goal.
sources.refresh_trigger: Before implementation of dependent health content or store submission; sooner if source changes

sources.title: Vegan versus omnivorous diets in identical twins
sources.publisher: Landry et al., JAMA Network Open via PubMed
sources.finding: An eight-week study of 22 twin pairs reported improvements in selected cardiometabolic measures on a healthy vegan diet.
sources.limitation: Small, short trial with initial meal provision; not a long-term universal superiority result.
sources.refresh_trigger: Before implementation of dependent health content or store submission; sooner if source changes

sources.title: Vitamin B12 consumer fact sheet
sources.finding: People eating little or no animal foods may have inadequate B12 intake.
sources.limitation: Nutrient planning must be individualized; no supplement dose chosen here.
sources.refresh_trigger: Before implementation of dependent health content or store submission; sooner if source changes

sources.title: High-protein diets during weight loss
sources.finding: Examines protein intake, fat-free mass and muscle protein synthesis during controlled weight loss.
sources.limitation: Research lead supports reviewing protein adequacy; a personal gram target is not derived in this phase. Direct full-page retrieval failed in this research pass; only indexed abstract material was available.
sources.refresh_trigger: Before implementation of dependent health content or store submission; sooner if source changes

sources.title: Ketogenic versus low-fat diet trial
sources.finding: A specific ketogenic program was compared with a low-fat program for obesity and hyperlipidemia.
sources.limitation: Older trial in a selected population; not a universal ranking or current safety review.

sources.title: Clear liquid diet
sources.finding: Clear-liquid diets serve specific medical purposes and require provider direction.
sources.limitation: Not a general long-term body-composition diet.

sources.title: Full liquid diet
sources.finding: Full-liquid diets differ from clear liquids and can have fiber and micronutrient limitations.
sources.limitation: Medical use does not establish suitability for self-directed weight loss.

sources.title: Physical activity and diet, NG246
sources.finding: Low/very-low-energy approaches are restricted to defined supported clinical strategies with nutritional completeness and duration requirements.
sources.limitation: UK clinical guidance; not a prescription for this owner or every commercial liquid product.

sources.title: Adult activity overview
sources.finding: General adult guidance combines aerobic activity with muscle-strengthening work on at least two days weekly.
sources.limitation: Population guidance is not an individualized beginner program or a requirement for daily hard workouts.

sources.title: Resistance training load trial

sources.finding: Studied higher- versus lower-repetition training in 49 trained men over 12 weeks, with sets to volitional failure.
sources.limitation: Research supports comparing training approaches; study conditions are not an instruction for a beginner to train to failure.
